eps.o: With the help of Pandy the Scarecrow, Baby Box the Tin Box, and Marty the Party Lion, Gabby must go to Emerald Kitty City and meet the Wizard of Meow, while dodging obstacles from “Bad Witch” MerCat along the way! Cat of the Day: MerCat sings “Spa Science”.

Cakey reveals an adorable mini eatery inside his kitchen cabinet! Gabby, Pandy and maitre d’CatRat help Cakey get all the things he needs to get his tiny restaurant ready for his tiny customers, the Hamster Kitties! Cat of the Day: Cakey makes a doughnut kitty.

eps.t: How to Train Your Kitty Dragon
eps.o: CatRat the Brave meets a baby kitty dragon who gets stuck on a marshmallow tower in the Kingdom of Squish. It’s up to brave knights Gabby the Bold and Pandy the Purr-oud to help CatRat rescue his dragon friend, only to discover he can’t see very well and needs an eye exam. Cat of the Day: Baby Box, with the help of Sparkle, makes a fire breathing dragon.

Gabby unboxes special magic bananas where there’s a little magic in every bite! Silly shenanigans ensue in the Dollhouse with the Gabby Cats taking turns surprising one another with their magical powers.

eps.t: Good to Be a Gabby Cat Game Show!
eps.o: Gabby hosts a game show in her bedroom, where the Gabby Cats are contestants as they celebrate the memories from the littlest wins to the biggest whoopsies.
